title: gnimsys-ui block v1
description: The JSON inside a fenced ```gnimsys-ui block of an AI Agent Studio reply, rendered by xxx-gnimsys-ai-chat as a form (contract 2026-10-26 rev 2). Every button submits the block's values plus its own data as ONE user message: '<button label> — <title>' (the label alone without a title), a newline, then <gnimsysSubmit id="<id>">{"<fieldId>": <value>, ..., <button data>}</gnimsysSubmit> with every field (hidden included), option values never labels, null for an unset single value and [] for an unset multi value, and the clicked button's data merged on top (button keys win). The workflow parses it with /<gnimsysSubmit id="([^"]+)">(.*?)</gnimsysSubmit>/, JSON.parse of group 2, and routes on the button data (e.g. decision).

kind.description: This version renders forms only; a choice is a form with one radio or checkbox field.

id.description: Widget id, unique within the message; echoed as the envelope's id.

title.description: Heading above the fields; also the readable line's tail.

fields.$comment: Field ids must be unique within the block (checked by the component; not expressible here).

buttons.description: At least one button; button ids and data are unique within the block (checked by the component).

value.description: What the submit carries; unique within the field.

description.description: Rendered under the label (the engine's AskBox pattern).

dataSource.description: The dashboard REST datasource shape, served by a JET DataProvider (xxx-gnimsys-data/rest/endpoint-data-provider) through the page's endpoints: fetchFirst substitutes the dropdown's typed text into the url's {{query}} placeholder (inside its q parameter; single quotes doubled) and appends limit (config datasources.pageSize, default 25) and offset; fetchByKeys sends q=<valueField> IN ('k1','k2') on the url with its whole q parameter removed. Response rows = the body when it is an array, else body.items, else the array at dataTransform.expression (map); hasMore / totalResults are read from the body. GET only. Inline (in a block) only when the config's datasources.allowInline is true and url starts with one of datasources.allowPrefixes; the config overlay widgets[widgetId].fields[fieldId] wins over it.

target.description: The endpoint (service connection) that makes the call.

url.description: Pod path; {{query}} inside its q parameter is the server search, e.g. /fscmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/subinventories?q=Description LIKE '{{query}}%'&fields=SubinventoryCode,Description. Do not put limit/offset in it (the provider appends them).

body.description: Sent as given (a string) or as JSON (an object), on methods with a body.

type.description: map: expression is the dotted path to the row array (default without a transform: the body when it is an array, else its items). lodash: the dashboard's expression form; the chat does not evaluate expressions and shows the field as unavailable.

required.description: Enforced by buttons whose validate is not false.

help.description: Short help text under the field.

selectField.description: oj-c-select-single, or oj-c-select-multiple when multi. Options inline OR from a datasource (dataSource + valueField + labelField), never both or neither.

valueField.description: Row field that becomes the option value (the DataProvider key).

labelField.description: Row field that becomes the option label (what the dropdown shows and the server search filters by).

radioField.description: oj-c-radioset: one value; options inline only.

checkboxField.description: oj-c-checkboxset: an array value; options inline only.

hiddenField.description: Not rendered; its value is echoed in the submit (turn state the workflow wants back).

id.description: Unique within the block; used by the chat for the read-only clicked mark only.

data.description: Merged into the submit JSON (button keys win over field ids): how the workflow learns which button was clicked, e.g. { "decision": "APPROVE" }. Unique within the block.

variant.description: Default: the first button callToAction, the others outlined.

validate.description: false = submit whatever is there (Back / Cancel), required fields not enforced.

confirm.description: Asks '<confirm> — OK / Cancel' inline before submitting.

searchTemplate.description: Typed-text search of a datasource select: minChars (default 1) before a request is made, debounceMs (default 250) between the last keystroke and the request.
